wording: [Vanguard of the King, the Phantom Storm]
holder-quote: Orthenon pointed ahead. And his words filled the silence.
effect-quote: Teres felt a sensation. She glanced sideways and stared. A woman wearing engraved armor rode at her left. It shone with silver and gold, and she carried a mace. Her hair was pale blue.

wording: [Vanguard of the King, the Phantom Storm]
effect-quote: Ghostly riders appeared around him. A second army to join the living, famed warriors of old!
